judgments.reason: General articles of association boilerplate. Mentions special rights (特別權利) for share classes and capital redemption reserve, but not investor redemption/put/repurchase rights. No actual investor, no specific redemption terms.

Liquidation procedures boilerplate. Mentions special rights (特別權利) only in context of asset distribution upon winding up, not investor redemption or put rights. No actual investor or redemption mechanism.
Corporate governance boilerplate on resolutions and voting. References special voting rights (表決特別權利) only, with zero connection to redemption, put, or repurchase rights. Least relevant of the three.
